sidecar.title: kube-noob as a sidecar on OpenShift (60 s)

scenes.caption: Your app and kube-noob, one pod
scenes.vo: Run kube-noob next to your own app, in the same pod.
scenes.say: Run kube noob next to your own app, in the same pod.

scenes.caption: Listens on 127.0.0.1 only
scenes.vo: It listens only on localhost, so only the containers in that pod can call it.

scenes.caption: DNS-only egress. No Service, no token.
scenes.vo: It makes no outbound calls, so its network policy allows DNS only. kube-noob gets no Service, no Route and no token to manage.
scenes.say: It makes no outbound calls, so its network policy allows D N S only. kube noob gets no Service, no Route, and no token to manage.

● kube-noob · kubenoob_audit_manifests (platform: openshift, version: 4.22)
score 37 · high 3 · medium 7 · low 5
HIGH  KN-S013  line 21  Secret value hard-coded in environment
HIGH  KN-S004  line 23  Fixed UID/fsGroup conflicts with OpenShift restricted-v2 SCC
HIGH  KN-S002  line 24  Privilege escalation not disabled
MED   KN-V011  line 32  Service selects no pods in this bundle
● kube-noob · kubenoob_fix_manifests
runAsUser: 1000 → removed · allowPrivilegeEscalation → false · seccomp → RuntimeDefault

scenes.caption: Claude explains. kube-noob checks.
scenes.vo: Claude explains the result in plain language and cites the rule ids.
scenes.say: Claude explains the result in plain language, and cites the rule ids.
answer: Security context that restricted-v2 rejects (KN-S004 and KN-S002, high)
Service selector is app: orders, but the pods are app: orders-api (KN-V011, medium)
